main_text.head: XII.
COSMOGRAPHIA.
main_text.p: 5I. COsmographia sacra est sphaerae mundi scientia ex S. literis illustrata.
II. Sphaera mundi est systema constans ex cœlo & terrâ. Hic itaque traduntur ea, quæ communiter conveniunt globo cœlesti & terrestri.10
III. In Sphærâ mundi considerantur cardines & circuli. De cardinibus aliquid invenitur in Scriptura sacra: circuli sunt hypotheses artificum.

IV. Cardines mundi sunt quatuor: videlicet 15oriens & occidens, septentrio & meridies. Gen. 13. verf. 14. Psal. 107. verf. 3. Oriens est veluti porta, per quam stellæ ingrediuntur in horizontem: occidens, per quem discedunt ex horizonte: Septentrio est cardo, in quo locu habet polus superior: meridies, in quo inferior. In Scriptura vocatur quatuor anguli terræ. Apoc. 7. v. 1. c. 20. v. 8. Crebro fit illorum mentio: ut orientis sive ortus Gen. 11. v. 2. c. 12. v. 8. Exod. 27. v. 13. Ios. 16. 17. 18. Ezech. 40. 41. 42. 43. 44. 45. 46. 47. Matth. 2. v. 1. 2. 9. Luc. 13. v. 29.20Apoc. 21. v. 13. occidentis sive occasus Gen. 12. v. 8. c. 13. v. 14. Exod. 27. v. 12. Ios. 11. v. 3. Ezech. 46. & 48. Zach. 14. verf. 4. Matth. 24. v. 27. Luc. 13. v. 29. septentrionis Gen. 28. v. 14. Iudic. 21. verf. 19. Ezech. 47. & 48. meridiei Gen. 12. verf. 9. Exod. 27. v. 9. Deut. 1. v. 7. Ezech. 47. & 48. In quibusdam locis iam citatis coniunguntur duo vel plures cardines.25 Cæterum iuxta hos cardines numeratur longitudo & latitudo mundi: quæ duo coniunguntur Gen. 13. v. 17. Longitudo mundi numeratur ab oriente versus occidentem, vel contra: latitudo, à septentrione versus meridiem, vel vicißim.3035

page.notes: Line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are printed in the left margin and are marked as notes at their places. The woodcut-like initial C of paragraph I is joined to its word. Some Greek-style abbreviations and the final mark after "terrestri" and "vicißim" are read from a small scan and may be misprinted; "viciffim" is read as printed with ff, shown here as vicißim, which is a doubtful reading. The Scripture references are copied as printed and not checked against the Bible. The signature "H 2" and catchword "V. Cir-" stand at the foot of the page.
